paite: Aw, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen un; Amah lah ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna leng tangtawn a om ding ahih ziak in.
heading: Vualzohna Ziak A Kipahna Thumna

paite: Azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding chih Israelte'n gen uhen.
Azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding chih, Aaron inkuante'n gen uhen.
Azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding chih, TOUPA kihtate'n gen uhen.
Ka mangbatna a kipan in TOUPA ka sam a, TOUPA'N hon dawng a, mun awngthawl ah hon omsakta hi.
TOUPA kei lam a pang ahi a, ka lau kei ding; mihing in bang ahon chih thei dia.
TOUPA kei lam a pang hon panpihte lak a ahi; huaiziak in hon doute tung ah ka thu deihtel ka mu ding hi.
Mihing muan sang in TOUPA a muanna koih ahoihzaw hi.
Miliante gintak sang in TOUPA a ginna koih ahoihzaw hi.
Nam chih in ahon umsuak ua; amau TOUPA min in ka hihmang ding.
Amau hon umsuak ua; ahi, hon umsuak ua; amau TOUPA min in ka hihmang ding hi.
Khuai bang in hon umsuak ua; ling meikuang bang in mihsak in a-om uh; amau TOUPA min in ka hihmang ding hi.
Ka pukna ding in hon sut na tum a; himahleh TOUPA'N ahon panpih geih hi.
TOUPA ka hatna leh ka la ahi, ka hotdamna leng ahong hita hi.
Kipahna leh hotdamna husa midiktatte puanin ah a-om hi, TOUPA khut taklam in hangsantak in ahih nak hi.
TOUPA khut taklam pahtawi in a-om nak a; TOUPA khut taklam in hangsantak in ahih nak hi.
Ka si kei ding, ka dam ding hi, TOUPA thilhihte ka theisak zaw ding.
TOUPA'N nakpitak in hon thuzoh a, sihna kiang ah zaw hon pe tel kei hi.
Diktatna kulh kongkhakte hon honsak un; huaite ah ka lut ding a, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu ka hilh ding hi.
Hiai TOUPA kongkhak ahi; midiktatte alut ding uh.
Na kiang ah kipahthu ka gen ding, nang hon dawng in, hon hondampa na hita ngal a.
Inn lamte suang deih louh aning a suang phatuampen ana hita hi.
Huai TOUPA hih ahi; i mitmuh uah alamdang ahi.
Hiai TOUPA ni seh ahi, hiai ah i nuam un i kipak ding uh.
TOUPA aw, hehpih in hon hondam inla, TOUPA aw, hehpih in vangphatna hon sawl in.
TOUPA min a hong pai in nuam asa hi; TOUPA' inn a pan in ka hon vualzawl uhi.
TOUPA Pathian ahi, ama'n vak ahon pia a, kithoihna ding khauhual in khih uhen, maitam kii mahmah ah.
Nang ka Pathian na hi a, kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a; ka Pathian na hi a, ka hon pahtawi ding hi.
Aw, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu hilh un; amah lah ahoih ngala; azahngaihna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
